notes.title: Update v1.0.3: QOL Improvements
notes.notes: [p]Thanks for playing 'Parking Together!' We've released a small update today (Version 1.0.3) that includes several Quality of Life (QOL) improvements.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]QOL[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Improved the UI after stage selection to more clearly distinguish between "Normal" and "Challenge" modes.[/p][/*][*][p]Players can now go directly to Challenge Mode 1-1 from the results screen after clearing stage 5-4.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor in-game text adjustments.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue on stage 1-1 where an invisible collision box was present at a specific location.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]This update will be applied automatically when you restart the Steam client.[/p][p]We're constantly working to make your parking life as enjoyable as possible. If you happen to find any other issues, please feel free to let us know in the Bug Report thread on the Community Hub![/p][p]The Parking Together! Dev Team[/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.2: Experience improvements for some stages
notes.notes:
[p]Thanks for playing 'Parking Together!'[/p][p]We've released a small update today (Version 1.0.2) with some user experience improvements for a few stages.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]What's Fixed[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]"4-2 Park of Terror":[/b] Fixed an issue that could cause the frame rate to drop.[/p][/*][*][p][b]"4-4 PARK HAZARD":[/b] Adjusted the unstable behavior of some stage mechanics.[/p][/*][*][p][b]"5-3 TEARS OF THE PARKING":[/b] Adjusted some of the terrain to improve the player experience.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][p]The update should be applied automatically the next time you restart your Steam client.[/p][p]We're always working to make your parking life as fun as possible. If you spot any other issues, please don't hesitate to let us know in the Bug Report thread on our Community Hub![/p][p]Thanks for your support, and happy parking![/p][p][/p][p]The Parking Together! Team[/p]
